<subject>Re: AgriTrade From Bharat Commodities</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn’t have the legal authority (and the filing never clarifies) to suspend deliveries under the Grain Supply Agreement (he likely lacks the regulatory backing for this as well).

AgriTrade, however, could endorse this in its submission as a way to advance the Farmer Producer Organization issue.

Hardik





	Reyansh Krish
	Sent by: Reyansh Krish
	20/3/2024 10:04 AM
		 
		 To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita 
Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya 
Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher 
Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat
		 cc: 
		 Subject: AgriTrade From Bharat Commodities

FYI. Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is contract release an "increase supply" option? My concern is that FPOs get released and then Maharashtra’s “regulatory clampdown” mentality kicks in, enforcing the Kripa Desai Act, etc. to ensure that the grain from the FPOs remains within Maharashtra.

Best,
Reyansh
</body>
